gen-dafont-junegull-gf-sintony: Chunky, retro and friendly, with curves pinched shut. Sintony takes over where Junegull's cast-iron lowercase stops, offering a smooth sans-serif with open curves, while the heading does its best work as a loud, closed-up shape.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans stands tall, rounded and open at the sides. Junegull's pinched, closed curves and cast-iron lowercase sit above it, so the page moves from a stubby retro shout to stencil-like, unmodulated lines.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Lowercase here nearly reaches the capitals, with a wide entrance into every curve. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed carries the reading in constant stencil-like strokes, so paragraphs flow smoothly under Junegull's pinched, retro heading.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-stack-sans-headli: Retro and friendly, with pinched curves. Stack Sans Headline brings a monoline skeleton and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, so shrinking Junegull would waste its cast-iron lowercase, while enlarging the sans would waste its precision.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like line with big-bodied lowercase. Under it, Junegull's pinched curves and cast-iron stature feel retro and closed, while the text face keeps every curve ending well apart.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-sulphur-point: Junegull's lowercase stands like cast iron capitals, its curves pinched almost shut. Sulphur Point answers with bulky sans letters whose gaps stay distinct, and its marker-like line keeps the retro heading friendly rather than heavy.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-tiktok-sans: Friendly retro swagger, pinched at every curve. TikTok Sans follows with a lowercase rising close to cap height and a spacious opening on the c, while Junegull earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans has lowercase eyes big as washers and tubular strokes like bent copper pipe. Junegull is best at closed, pinched, retro shapes with cast-iron weight, whereas Ubuntu Sans does best with those pen-lifted, open curves.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-vend-sans: No thick-thin flicker here, just pinched curves and a cast-iron lowercase. Vend Sans draws a ruler-straight line with wide, unclosed terminals and an x-height that fills the line, which makes the two feel like a stamp beside a stencil.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-yaldevi: Retro, friendly and pinched shut at every curve. Junegull earns its keep big and brief, while Yaldevi's outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right take over the rest.
